g AS (SELECT store_key, product_key, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT closing_units) du, count(DISTINCT closing_value) dv, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) de FROM w GROUP BY 1,2)

WITH w AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-02-23' AND '2026-03-22')
SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) noprod,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(w.closing_value - w.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outofver
FROM w LEFT JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key)
